name: Chains of Eternity
source:
Step into the troubled mind of Nolan Black, a man torn between his fragile humanity and the darkness that lurks within. 

By day, he struggles to survive the monotony of office life under the watchful eye of his demanding boss. By night – and within his own thoughts – he wrestles with impulses far more dangerous than mere frustration.

[From [url=https://alexkonkoly.itch.io/chains-of-eternity]Itch.io[/url]]
